release_installer.execution: root-only orchestration from a verified extracted release archive
release_installer.python: Python 3.12+ required before Pegasus invocation; Python 3.9 unsupported

ownership: exact files, symlinks, and retirement tombstones with digest/link checks and per-collision backups; never recursive shared-directory ownership

preserves: provider names recorded as integration evidence
unrelated MCP names recorded as integration evidence

clients.claude_code: canonical skills and CLAUDE.md only; no plugins

release_distribution: semantic-version immutable annotated tags and GitHub Releases with archive, SHA-256 checksum, checksummed install.sh asset, and release manifest; no remote updater is bundled
prohibited_runtime: native review agents except approved explicit JD agents
post_migration_integrity: pegasus validate checks every exact owned asset plus retained integration evidence; active-runtime-baseline.json is frozen historical evidence only
